I replied to Pree in her #central-random thread: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it on #8841 for support. Pree is in that channel, so she can see the message herself.

His message never names Marrow Fieldworks. He was answering a question about "Tobias's dealer account" and mentioned the Plains depots. A January team digest calls Marrow Fieldworks a dealer account that was changing hands on Jan 5, so it's very likely the same one. I still asked Pree to have Tobias confirm before her call.
